About the job
 

As a Patent Paralegal, you will provide administrative support for formal patent procedures in Belgium, Europe and abroad. Your responsibilities will include:
 
 

• Corresponding with clients, foreign agents and patent granting authorities such as the European Patent Office 

• Registering and following up on patent-related deadlines 

• Monitoring worldwide changes in procedural matters and implementing these changes in our procedures 

• Coordinating the filing of patent applications 

• Carrying out general administrative tasks  

About you
 

We are looking for someone who:
 
 

• Holds a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree 

• Has a strong judicial affinity 

• Has excellent written and oral communication skills in Dutch and English; other languages are a plus 

• Handles confidential matters with discretion 

• Has excellent Microsoft Office skills 

• Is proactive, takes initiative and knows how to set priorities 

• Has strong attention to detail 

• Can work both independently and as part of a team 

• Ideally has some experience as a Patent Paralegal, although this is not required

As a Production Shift Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily operations of a modern packaging and production department. You lead a team of approximately 150 employees across multiple packaging lines and ensure that production targets, quality standards and customer requirements are achieved efficiently and safely.
 

You are a visible leader on the shop floor, coaching and supporting your team while continuously looking for opportunities to improve processes, efficiency and performance.
 

What will you do?
 

 
• Lead and support a large operational team, including direct supervision of team leaders.
 
• Monitor production planning, quality, safety and productivity targets.
 
• Coordinate closely with planning, logistics and maintenance teams to ensure smooth daily operations.
 
• Follow up on employee performance, coaching and development.
 
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational efficiencies.
 
• Ensure products meet the highest quality standards and customer expectations. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You have experience in a supervisory role within a production, packaging or food manufacturing environment.
 
• You are a strong people manager who can motivate, coach and develop teams.
 
• You remain calm under pressure and can effectively prioritize in a dynamic environment.
 
• You have an interest in production processes and a willingness to develop your technical knowledge.
 
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English; knowledge of Romanian is an asset.
 
• You are quality-focused, hands-on and solution-oriented.
 
• You understand the flexibility required in a fresh food environment where quality and customer service are key.

• Maintain strong relationships with existing clients while proactively identifying and developing new business opportunities.

• Ability to work effectively under pressure . 
• Team player with a proactive and positive attitude.

We are looking for an analytical and customer-focused Junior Technical Support Specialist to join our team and become the technical anchor for our clients. In this role you will support domain experts in model/AI risk management, model development, model validation,… who rely on us for complex product queries, custom configurations and bug resolution. This requires a deep understanding of our solutions and the ability to solve technical puzzles. You will take full ownership of client questions ensuring that users receive the right advice, can use the product effectively and have their issues resolved quickly and efficiently. As you master our platform and understand the different configurations of our clients, this role offers a clear growth path towards an implementation consultant or customer success account management role.
 

How you'll make an impact
 
 

• Take ownership of complex product inquiries, guiding our customers through technical challenges and platform usage via our service desk. 

• Adapt and adjust existing custom configurations tailored to the needs of our clients. 

• Create and maintain 
customer-facing support documentation and tutorial videos. 

• Thoroughly reproduce, verify and analyze reported bugs, resolving what you can and 
accurately translating issues for the product team. 

• Own the end-to-end communication for client issues, ensuring the user stays informed and guided even when an issue is escalated. 

• Build a deep 
understanding of each client’s specific setup to provide proactive support. 

• Collaborate closely with internal teams (product team, Information Security team) to ensure timely and high-quality support. 

What we're looking for
 
 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, Business Engineering, or a similar field, or equivalent experience in a similar role. 

• A customer-centric professional with 
excellent communication skills who genuinely enjoys helping experts solve complex problems. 

• Fluency in 
English ( 
spoken and written) is an absolute must. 

• Ability to translate business needs or functional problems into 
clear technical requirements. 

• A 
strong analytical mindset. You don’t just pass along an issue, you investigate the root cause and resolve the issue yourself or introduce short-term workarounds to unblock the client. 

• A strong affinity for 
complex enterprise SaaS software solutions combined with the eagerness to learn about MRM and AI governance. 

• Python skills are a plus. 

• Hands-on experience in database and SQL is a plus. 

• A high 
ownership mentality, taking full responsibility issues from the moment they are raised until the final solution is communicated. 

• An 
ambitious individual looking to grow into an implementation consultant expert or account manager role focused on deep product expertise.

jobs.description:

About the role
 

Fintensy builds and operates the technology platform behind mozzeno and other financial services. As we scale, we're looking for a Head of IT to grow our engineering team, sharpen how we work, and make sure our technology delivers on the business's ambitions.
 

This is a leadership role first and foremost. You will spend your time developing people, aligning ways of working, leading our technical initiatives, and giving stakeholders clear visibility into what the team is building and where it is headed. While you won't be writing production code day to day, your credibility with the team comes from having built and operated systems like these yourself.
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

• Team leadership & coaching — Provide mentorship and day-to-day support to developers and data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning. Help senior engineers grow junior colleagues and keep knowledge flowing across the team. 

• Technical project leadership — Lead the delivery of technical projects end to end — infrastructure, platform, security, tooling and cross-cutting engineering initiatives — from scoping through rollout. Business-driven projects are owned by Product Owners; you partner closely with them while taking the lead on the technical roadmap and its execution. 

• Recruitment & onboarding — Lead hiring for developers, infrastructure engineers, and data & AI specialists. Design and oversee onboarding that integrates new hires quickly and effectively into the team and its practices. 

• Process refinement — Work with Product Owners to shape and fine-tune agile practices (backlog management, sprint planning, retrospectives) that maximise productivity and keep focus on strategic priorities. Continuously trial new techniques — such as AI-assisted coding and process automation — to raise efficiency and quality. 

• Visibility & communication — Ensure transparent reporting of achievements, roadmaps and risks to stakeholders. Run regular updates on progress, risks and resource needs, and build a shared understanding of priorities across engineering, product and business. 

• Collaboration & facilitation — Act as the bridge between developers, Product Owners, data scientists and external partners. Facilitate discussions on requirements and dependencies so projects run smoothly and teams stay aligned. 

• Technical oversight — Bring deep, hands-on experience with our stack or equivalent (AWS, .NET, Angular, Python, event-driven micro-services), enough real depth to debug a production issue or challenge an architectural decision yourself, not just follow the conversation.  Champion security best practices and infrastructure improvements, while delegating implementation to subject-matter experts. 

• Culture & growth — Foster an environment where engineers feel accountable and empowered to take ownership. Encourage curiosity and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset, and promote AI and emerging tools that streamline work and sharpen the team's skills. 
 

• Several years of hands-on experience as a Software Engineer, Architect, or DevOps/Platform Engineer, ideally followed by a move into a people-management or tech-lead role. 
 

• Experience managing engineering or cross-functional teams, with a track record of coaching people and growing their skills. 

• A record of leading technical projects or initiatives through to delivery. 

• Proven ability to design and refine agile or lean processes that improve delivery effectiveness. 

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable presenting plans, progress and blockers to technical and non-technical audiences alike. 

• Organised and detail-oriented, able to juggle multiple initiatives without losing sight of the big picture. 

• Comfortable introducing new tools and techniques (e.g., AI-assisted development) and measuring their impact. 

• Enough technical literacy in cloud infrastructure, web technologies and DevOps pipelines to understand team challenges and shape high-level decisions. 

• Fluency in French or Dutch alongside professional English.  

Nice to have
 
 

• Prior experience in fintech or other regulated environments. 

• Experience working with near-shore or hybrid teams.

jobs.description:
As a butcher in our wholesale department, you are responsible for expertly processing quality meat for professional customers in Belgium and abroad. You work precisely and efficiently in a modern production environment where craftsmanship is key. Your duties include deboning, cutting, and portioning beef, pork, lamb, and poultry to the specified weights and customer requirements. You also prepare ground meats and charcuterie, conduct quality checks, and ensure products are packaged and labeled correctly.

A typical workday starts early in the morning. You begin at 6:00 am with your close-knit team. Your responsibilities include deboning, cutting, and weighing meat, always paying attention to detail and quality. You follow strict procedures to guarantee food safety and contribute to a smooth production flow. During lunch, you and your colleagues enjoy our house-made meat products, and you finish your workday by 2:00 pm.

Are you a skilled professional who likes to roll up your sleeves and is committed to quality? Apply today and join our team of passionate butchers!

• Thorough knowledge of the complete breakdown and deboning of a beef carcass (very important)

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL 

The Tribe Artificial Intelligence aims to deliver an efficient and seamless banking experience for our customers and empower our employees through AI. Our expert team of approximately 90 experts includes Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, Product Owners and Managers. We are seeking a Data Scientist with a minimum of 3 years of experience in developing AI applications, including both generative and predictive AI. 

 

AND IN DETAIL 

• You develop AI applications to address various business challenges, including virtual assistants to enhance client experiences, advanced AI tools to support employee efficiency and creativity, and automation to optimize internal processes. 
• You use various analytical methods, including large language models (Prompt Engineering, RAG, Fine-tuning), speech-to-text, agentic AI applications, image generation and interpretation, and classical statistical/machine learning techniques. While expertise in all areas is not required, strong proficiency in core technologies and the ability to learn new methods as needed are essential. 
• You contribute to deploying AI applications in production using a comprehensive stack of tools. 
• You access one of the richest volumes of varied data in the market and apply your skills to it. 
• You evolve in an environment where innovation and lean processes are praised, straight-forward communication is encouraged, and peers understand the meaning of team up. 
• You work with a team of colleagues in an Agile organization who are ready to collaborate and to share their experience. 

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES 

• You hold at least a Master’s degree in a quantitative field like statistics, computer science or engineering, with a focus on natural language processing. A PhD is advantageous. Candidates from other academic backgrounds with strong analytics knowledge are also welcome. 
• You have a minimum of 3 years' experience in data science, preferably in the financial sector, though less experience may be accepted if your academic achievements are substantial. 
• You are fluent in English and have a good command of French and/or Dutch. 
• You are proficient in Python for model building and understand ML engineering fundamentals (e.g., versioning systems) to produce code ready for CI/CD integration.
